journey.name: Allowance Paused After Restore
journey.description: A payer restored from its recovery phrase pays nothing automatically until it resumes: the Allowances tab shows "Automatic payments paused" with the restore explanation, a request within the limits asks as an ordinary Payment Request, the pause survives a relaunch, and Resume brings automatic payments back. Reset And Restore wipes the keychain, so a restore on the same instance is enough. Requires the Active allowance from set-and-accept.xml, the payer's notification permission granted and a usable channel on the payer after the restore. The journey wipes the payer half way through, so do not run it against a wallet whose funds matter.

actions.action: Launch the E2E Bitkit app on both instances with the $5 a payment, $50 a month allowance from set-and-accept.xml Active, and the payer's notification permission granted

On the payer instance, open the menu, navigate to Settings, then the "Security" tab (id "Tab-security"), then tap "Back Up Your Money" (id "BackupWallet"), continue past the intro (id "BackupIntroViewContinue"), tap to reveal the phrase (id "TapToReveal") and record the phrase from the word grid (id "SeedContainer")

Open Settings, then the "Security" tab, then "Data Backups" (id "BackupSettings"), and wait on the list (id "BackupScrollView") until the "Boosts & Transfers" row reports a backup made after the allowance became Active — that row carries no id, so read its text
Open Settings, then the "Security" tab, then "Reset And Restore" (id "ResetAndRestore"), tap "Reset Wallet" and confirm with "Yes, Reset" in the alert — neither carries an id, so tap them by label
On the onboarding screen tap "Restore" (id "RestoreWallet"), then "MultipleDevices-button", enter the recorded words into the word inputs (id "Word-0" onwards) and tap Restore (id "RestoreButton")
Wait for the restore to finish and tap "Get Started" (id "GetStartedButton")
Open the drawer menu, tap Subscriptions and tap the Allowances tab (id "Tab-allowances")

Verify the paused notice (id "AllowancesPaused") reads "Automatic payments paused" and "This wallet was restored from a backup. Requests ask for your approval until you resume.", and the payee's row (id "AllowanceRow-<entryId>") is listed as Active
On the payee instance, open the drawer menu, tap Subscriptions, tap the Payments tab (id "Tab-payments") and send the payer a one-time Payment Request for $2 with the note "Paused"

Switch to the payer instance and verify the Payment Request sheet (id "PaymentRequestsSheet") opens for $2.00 from the payee, or the bell (id "PaymentRequestsBell") shows one pending request, and that no "Payment Executed" notification is posted
Terminate Bitkit on the payer instance, relaunch it, open the drawer menu, tap Subscriptions and tap the Allowances tab, and verify the paused notice (id "AllowancesPaused") is still shown
Tap Resume (id "AllowancesResume"), complete the PIN check if one is asked, and verify the paused notice is gone
On the payee instance, send the payer a one-time Payment Request for $2 with the note "Resumed"

Switch to the payer instance, with Bitkit in the foreground, and verify no Payment Request sheet opens and a "Payment Executed" notification with the text "Auto-pay sent $2.00 to <payee>" is posted as a banner, or under Bitkit in Notification Center
